I am a Professor of [Information](https://www.si.umich.edu/), [Complex Systems](https://www.lsa.umich.edu/cscs/), and [Computer Science](https://www.cse.umich.edu/) at the University of Michigan.

I study how network structure, identity, and relational context impact the production and dissemination of information, knowledge, culture, and behavior in online, scientific, and organizational settings.

I received my Ph.D. at the [Cornell University Center for Applied Mathematics](http://www.cam.cornell.edu/), where I was advised by [Jon Kleinberg](http://www.cs.cornell.edu/home/kleinber/). Before coming to Michigan, I was a postdoctoral researcher at the [Northwestern University Institute on Complex Systems](http://www.northwestern.edu/nico/), working with [Brian Uzzi](http://www.kellogg.northwestern.edu/faculty/uzzi/htm/).
